subject: Secure development controls: code-review samples, CI immutability, and secrets provenance
messages:
From: Emma Kline <emma.kline@assessco.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CAIQ/SIG follow-up - secure development artifacts

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. As part of BrightBank's SIG review we need a short bundle showing how Redwood demonstrates secure development controls for the scope of our evaluation. Specifically the assessor is asking for: 

- A representative code-review sample (redacted) that shows reviewer comments, approval timeline, and merge provenance.
- CI job output showing reproducible immutability (build IDs, artifact checksums, job run IDs).
- A mapped inventory of where secrets live and the rotation cadence (no raw secrets, just custody map).
- Change-management evidence for a small production deploy (request, approval, and rollback steps).

Can you provide a single archive or a set of links we can download by EOD Friday (two business days)? If there are any controls that you cannot share, note the reason and a pointer to where BrightBank can get equivalent assurance (e.g., SOC 2 report pages, artifact attestations).

If helpful, loop in people on your side who own CI / release and app security — cc'ing Peter Farrell from BrightBank (peter.farrell@brightbank.com) so he has visibility.

Regards,
Emma Kline
Assurance Lead
AssessCo

--
AssessCo sample request ID: AC-20270914-03
From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ/SIG follow-up - secure development artifacts

Emma — thanks, we can deliver. High-level plan and timeline below. I'll coordinate internal owners and hand you a download bundle + manifest by Friday EOD PST.

What you'll receive: 
- code_review_sample_manifest.txt (redacted diffs + reviewer comments, timestamps, PR metadata)
- ci_job_log_20270915.txt (sanitized job output with run IDs and artifact checksums)
- secrets-stewardship-mapping.csv (roles, KMS/HSM mapping, rotation cadence)
- k8s_change_manifest_20270913.yaml (deployment request, approver, and rollback snippet)

Internal owners (copied): Ben (CI artifacts + build immutability), Monica (secrets mapping + KMS detail), Grace (change approvals and production rollback trails).

If you need the raw artifacts under an NDA, we can arrange a secure transfer — otherwise we will sanitize and include manifests and checksums.

I'll update this thread with links and a short manifest as items are collected.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: none yet (we'll assemble).
From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 14:20:05 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: BrightBank SIG - collect artifacts for assessor

Team — please treat this as high priority for BrightBank's SIG assessment. Emma from AssessCo requested a small bundle showing code review, CI immutability, secrets mapping, and a change record. Target delivery: Fri EOD PST (2027-09-17).

Ask breakdown (short):
- Ben: provide one representative CI build output (sanitized) that shows build ID, artifact checksum, and the job run ID. Please also export the build signature/checksum verification steps and include job ID tracebacks. File name: ci_job_log_20270915.txt
- Monica: produce a secrets custody mapping (roles, KMS key ids, rotation schedule, and evidence of last rotation). No secrets in clear. File: secrets-stewardship-mapping.csv
- Grace: extract the change request and approval for a small deployment on 2027-09-13. Include approver email thread and the rollback command snippet (do not include private keys). File: k8s_change_manifest_20270913.yaml
- All: include a short manifest (code_review_sample_manifest.txt) pointing to a redacted PR (remove PII, tokens, and third-party credentials). The manifest must list reviewers, timestamps, and merge commit SHA.

Notes: for anything that is sensitive we will place it into a secure transfer (SFTP or private Drive with expiring link) and note that in the manifest. If any control is documented in SOC 2 we can reference the page + section instead of full artifacts.

Please reply-all with status by EOD Wed so I can validate before packaging.

Thanks,
Aisha
